    # fixture's git-init/commit may target the real repository instead.
    names = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "--local-env-vars"], cwd=REPO_ROOT, text=True,
    ).splitlines()
    for name in names:
        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
